title: MiSCHiEF: A Benchmark in Minimal-Pairs of Safety and Culture for Holistic Evaluation of Fine-Grained Image-Caption Alignment
reasoning: The paper introduces the MiC (Minimal-pairs in Culture) dataset, which contains specific categories for evaluating model performance on 'Religious Activities' and 'Religion Only' (Section D.1, Section D.3, and page 21). Additionally, the MiS (Minimal-pairs in Safety) component evaluates model reasoning in safety-critical and ethical risk scenarios.
